intent: Gen IV apex corrupted void shader for the same Redjack enemy: preserve prior treatment, push the palette-tinted silhouette to near-black, add a dense layered void-breach network, pronounced violet/magenta interference, controlled scanline distortion, and an almost white-hot reactor core.

delta.lighting_override: Same high-contrast top-down lighting as Gen III with apex-level reactor and interference bloom.
delta.detail: Build directly on Gen III without changing geometry: make the shader visibly unstable and distinct through layered void-breach detail—deep black panel voids beneath segmented red/pink fracture channels, branching multi-scale crack paths, offset ghost contours, sparse chromatic violet/magenta echoes, horizontal scanline bands, tiny phase-shifted pixel breaks, and localized energy shedding around the silhouette. The reactor should have a white-hot center, a red/pink containment layer, and a violet interference halo, while the outer hull remains readable and the corruption stays shader-driven rather than adding parts.

constraints: preserve the exact Redjack silhouette, reactor placement, wing geometry, engine blocks, scale, and orientation
use the existing Redjack red energy and pale red accent palette with violet as the corruption layer
one centered enemy on the same deep navy starfield treatment as the earlier stages
Gen IV must be the apex of the same material family, not a new model or unrelated effect
avoid: overexposed bloom that erases the silhouette
fracture noise that destroys the Redjack silhouette
